name: Rogue
description: Rogue class. 2024 SRD 5.2.1 progression; some tactical class features are recorded as unavailable.

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose two proficient skills for Expertise through the shared saved choice path.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, add the level-scaled Sneak Attack dice to an eligible finesse or ranged weapon hit when you have Advantage or an ally is near the target.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.description: Thieves' Cant and the additional language choice are not represented by the game.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Choose two proficient weapon types using the shared saved Weapon Mastery path.

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: Use the shared Bonus Action path to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

3.name: Rogue Subclass
3.description: Choose a Rogue subclass. Subclass features are stored in separate records; no Rogue subclass records currently ship.

3.name: Steady Aim
3.description: As a Bonus Action, gain Advantage on the next attack this turn, provided you have not moved; your Speed becomes 0 until the turn ends.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: Use your Reaction to halve damage from an attack that hits you.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, trade Sneak Attack dice for Poison, Trip, Withdraw, or (at level 14) Daze, Knock Out, and Obscure. You can apply up to two distinct effects.

6.name: Expertise
6.description: Choose two more proficient skills for Expertise through the shared saved choice path.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: Shared Evasion behavior applies to Dexterity saves for damaging area effects.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.description: On a proficient ability check, a d20 result below 10 counts as 10.

9.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
9.description: Subclass progression is stored in separate subclass records.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.description: You can use up to two distinct Cunning Strike effects when you deal Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each.

13.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
13.description: Subclass progression is stored in separate subclass records.

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.description: Adds Daze (2d6), Knock Out (6d6), and Obscure (3d6) as Cunning Strike options.

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

17.name: Rogue Subclass Feature
17.description: Subclass progression is stored in separate subclass records.

18.name: Elusive
18.description: Attack rolls against you cannot have Advantage unless you are Incapacitated.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon through the shared Character Sheet path.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, turn a failed D20 Test into a 20. The current prompt supports event skill checks.
